page.overview:
Who is Roma Atani?

Mentat Roma Atani was the cool and impassive Mentat of House Ordos and interpreter of the Executrix council at the time of the Battle for Dune. She was responsible for briefing new Ordos generals on the state of the war on Arrakis. Atani was not one to give criticism, believing that one achieved the directive of the Ordos, or they did not. Those who did not were subject to the torture devices of the Ordos, thus criticism was seen as pointless in the eyes of the Mentat.
